detail.title: Investigating Endocrine-Neurological Pathways
detail.summary: Continued research into the project 'Hormonal Regulation of Nervous System Function'. The existing provisional synthesis remains limited by metadata; I am now initiating a focused search to move beyond reference indices and identify specific physiological or clinical mechanisms.

detail.reason: The current notebook is based solely on bibliographic metadata. This search aims to retrieve specific, source-backed evidence detailing how endocrine imbalances (e.g., thyroid, adrenal) manifest as neurological sequelae, moving beyond references to actual mechanisms.
